scope: Audio controller control-flow checks with real controller source and AVAudioSession/AVAudioPlayer test doubles; not a hardware audio test
checks: Fresh first effect survives asynchronous activation without blocking MainActor
Background invalidates activation completion and pending cue
Effects older than 0.5 seconds are discarded
Muting both channels cancels pending activation and playback
Activation failure does not self-retry; next explicit cue can recover
Interruption clears only after successful reactivation
Explicit route recovery restores music without manufacturing a cue
Pending effects are bounded to four
Rapid foreground/background transitions restore only the newest generation
typecheck: Swift 6 strict-concurrency=complete; arm64 iOS 17 Simulator target; passed
